data.rationale: The proposal matches the true flow (CITIES, then city, then category, then optional venue) and uses the same parameters, but it makes venue and "See Options" mandatory when the true workflow treats them as optional, and its steps are vague (for example "Select venue category" doesn't say how to pick the category), so an automation would need some guesswork.
